title: The Mystery of the Gobekli Tepe Temple

scenes.text: 11,000 years old, Gobekli Tepe is the oldest known temple in the world
The temple features intricate carvings and sculptures of animals and humans
Gobekli Tepe is considered one of the most important archaeological discoveries of the 21st century
But what was the purpose of this ancient temple, and what can it tell us about the origins of human civilization?
